question: Tell me about a time when you helped identify a need and propose a solution.
answer: Well, the class was on Tuesdays, although sometimes we changed rooms, and choosing a group wasn't easy because our schedules were different. I really like well-designed apps and use them a lot to stay organized. For Study Space I prepared a guide, took part in two interviews and collected the notes. It was hard to see the available times, so I suggested showing them up front. A teammate designed the prototype. Anyway, we also had other exams, and we used to chat, usually in the evening. One student found the times clearer and the other wanted a filter by room capacity. I learned to check what people need before choosing a feature, which I think applies to other projects and to life in general.
expected: Recognizes the personal action, user need and actual feedback already present.
